text: You just bought a three-scoop ice cream. Don't drop it.
In a few seconds, every person on Earth jumps. At once.
Eight billion people. All off the ground.
The man next to you turns a page. Mid-air.
Mittens did not jump. Mittens is not a person.
Every street, every office, every rooftop. Nobody is touching the ground.
It's three a.m. in Tokyo. Someone had to wake them up for this.
From space, the whole planet is hovering.
The astronauts can't join in. They're already floating.
This was your idea, by the way.
Eight billion people land at once.
The strangest part? We all pushed the planet at once, and Earth moved less than a thousandth of the width of an atom.
